rows.label: tlk70000001_01_msg0001
rows.name:
There are all kinds of shops in the
shopping district, mo. The Chamber of
Commerce supports them, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_01_msg0002
rows.name:
There are plenty of problems one
person can't solve, mo. That's why
everyone puts heads together, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_01_msg0003
rows.name:
One for all, all for one. Working
together is what the Chamber of
Commerce is about, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000001_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Morumo is its chairman, mo. I also
represent the shopping district, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_01_msg0005
rows.name:
If you ever want your own shop, come
see Morumo, mo! I'll always be happy
to advise you, mooo!
